mapper.sql: SELECT audit_plan_id, audit_plan_no, audit_title, audit_year, audit_type, audit_scope, lead_auditor, audit_date_from, audit_date_to, audit_conclusion, plan_status, del_flag, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM qms_audit_plan
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qms_audit_plan (audit_plan_no, audit_title, audit_year, audit_type, audit_scope, lead_auditor, audit_date_from, audit_date_to, audit_conclusion, plan_status, del_flag, status, create_by, create_time, remark) VALUES (#{auditPlanNo}, #{auditTitle}, #{auditYear}, #{auditType}, #{auditScope}, #{leadAuditor}, #{auditDateFrom}, #{auditDateTo}, #{auditConclusion}, #{planStatus}, #{delFlag}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.update:
UPDATE qms_audit_plan audit_plan_no = #{auditPlanNo}, audit_title = #{auditTitle}, audit_year = #{auditYear}, audit_type = #{auditType}, audit_scope = #{auditScope}, lead_auditor = #{leadAuditor}, audit_date_from = #{auditDateFrom}, audit_date_to = #{auditDateTo}, audit_conclusion = #{auditConclusion}, plan_status = #{planStatus}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark},
WHERE audit_plan_id = #{auditPlanId}
mapper.delete: UPDATE qms_audit_plan SET del_flag = '2' WHERE audit_plan_id IN #{auditPlanId}
